name: Ritchey WCS Rizer handlebar
description:
The 100% badass Ritchey WCS Rizer is formed from triple-butted 7050 aluminum, using extra material where it's needed for unmatched strength and less where possible to reduce unnecessary weight, helping to make this incredibly engineered bar light and durable.
Featuring a 20mm rise, 9° backsweep, and 2° upsweep, and a textured center clamp area for maximum stem grip, the WCS Rizer provides comfort, confidence and a smooth, refined shred.

description:

Landing comfortably right between the B302AA North Road and B352 Albatross, Nitto's B347AA Dove features graceful curves with around 50mm or rise or drop, depending on which way you have them flipped. Perfect for city cruisin'.

name: Nitto B303AAF Gander handlebar - silver
description:
Nitto's B303AAF Gander is like a narrower, shorter version of the B352 Albatross Bar, with a slightly more "square-ish" bend that we think is rad. It's also got that classic Nitto center sleeve, which we also think is rad.
At 530mm wide with a 165mm grip space, they're the perfect width cruising and there's just enough room for track grips, which always look super cool on townie bars.
These can be run with rise or drop, depending on your steez.
Available in silver and black.
